sourceRefs.locator: III.6 and III.18. The pursuit at Visorontia, Godomar’s recovery of his kingdom, Clotild’s care for the boys and the fate of Chlodomer’s sons. The call imitating the king’s men is Gregory’s account of his death.
III.11. Chlothar and Childebert besiege Augustodunum. Godomar flees. Gregory links the siege with the acquisition of Burgundy.
Attestation 292. Gregory III.11, Latin and translation, siege of Autun and flight of Godomar. The record indexes the event under 534.

summary.de: Chlodomers Gegner bei Vézeronce. Gregor verbindet seine spätere Flucht aus Autun mit dem Ende des burgundischen Königtums.
summary.en: Chlodomer’s opponent at Vézeronce. Gregory connects his later flight from Autun with the end of the Burgundian kingship.
